audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 matches 51.02% over 6057 games: Viktor owns pre-6 (Katarina has no sustain and no trade pattern before resets), her 6-plus-first-item window is the danger, and two-item Viktor zones and interrupts her.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text, whys[2] and early used the fabricated 'Death Ray' for Viktor's E; phases[4].why used 'Chaos Storm' for his R. Spike structure (dominant 3-5, her flip at 6, her first item, your two-item swing) is right and matches the packet chart.
audit.why: Kit file: E = Hextech Ray (12/11/10/9/8), R = Arcane Storm (120/100/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive numbers were absent: Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 (and near-zero during Voracity resets), Death Lotus is only 75s at rank 1, her R is a channel your Gravity Field stun cancels, and her Shunpo range is 725 — longer than your 525 laser. Nine fields also misgendered her as he/his.
audit.why: Kit: Katarina E 12/11/10/9/8 dash 725; R 75/60/45 channel flag; P reduces cooldowns on takedown; W tosses a dagger with move speed on 15s. Viktor W hardCC interrupts channels when the stun lands.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 12s/75s/17s; W-as-interrupt stated; all lint-flagged pronouns corrected in the fields edited.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Now carries Shunpo 12s, Death Lotus 75s, Gravity Field 17s.
